stories.title: Israel relembra as vítimas de 7 de outubro antes das eleições

en.title: Israel remembers victims of October 7 ahead of elections
en.summary: Israel commemorated the third anniversary of a Hamas attack that killed many people, with a moment of silence at the exact time the assault began. The commemoration occurred days before elections significantly marked by remembrance of the deadliest day in Israeli history.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3067: 25 apostas do oeste do PA acertam a quadra; prêmio vai a R$ 100 milhões

en.title: Mega-Sena 3067: 25 bets from western PA hit four numbers; prize reaches R$ 100 million
en.summary: Twenty-five lottery tickets sold in western and southwestern Pará matched four numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3067. The jackpot accumulated to over 100 million reais after no ticket matched all six numbers nationwide.

stories.title: Cientistas ganham Nobel de Química 2026 por resolverem ‘mistério químico’ de um 1 século

en.title: Scientists win 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for resolving century-old chemical mystery
en.summary: Scientists were awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for solving a chemical puzzle that had remained unsolved for approximately one hundred years.

stories.title: Nobel de Química 2026 vai para pesquisas que fazem a química escolher imagens espelhadas

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry goes to research making chemistry select mirror images
en.summary: Henri Kagan from Paris-Sud University in France and Kenso Soai from Tokyo University of Science in Japan received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discoveries of nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.title: Nobel de Química 2025: entenda como dois cientistas descobriram o mecanismo que faz moléculas 'escolherem' um lado

en.title: Chemistry Nobel 2025: understand how two scientists discovered the mechanism that makes molecules 'choose' a side
en.summary: French scientist Henri B. Kagan and Japanese scientist Kenso Soai won the Chemistry Nobel Prize for discovering how to control chemical reactions to produce only one of two mirror-image forms of a molecule, a discovery with applications in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

stories.title: Nobel de Química 2026: quem são Henri Kagan e Kenso Soai, os cientistas que decifraram o 'espelho' da química da vida

en.title: Chemistry Nobel 2026: who are Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai, the scientists who deciphered the 'mirror' of life's chemistry
en.summary: French researcher Henri B. Kagan and Japanese researcher Kenso Soai received the 2026 Chemistry Nobel Prize for discovering methods to produce single mirror-image forms of molecules. They will share 12 million Swedish crowns in prize money.

stories.title: Nobel de Química 2026 vai para Henri Kagan e Kenso Soai pela descoberta sobre como moléculas 'escolhem' um lado

en.title: Chemistry Nobel 2026 goes to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for discovery of how molecules 'choose' a side
en.summary: Henri Kagan of France and Kenso Soai of Japan won the 2026 Chemistry Nobel Prize for discovering nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. They share a prize of 12 million Swedish crowns.

stories.title: Senado retoma nesta quarta discussão sobre PEC do fim da escala 6x1

en.title: Senate resumes on Wednesday discussion about PEC ending 6x1 work schedule
en.summary: Brazil's Senate resumed debate on a constitutional amendment that would eliminate the 6x1 work schedule after it advanced in the Chamber. Opposition leaders are coordinating absences and the vote outcome remains uncertain.

stories.title: Eleição para reitor do IFPB tem 2º turno nesta quarta-feira (7)

en.title: Second round of election for IFPB rector takes place this Wednesday (7)
en.summary: The Federal Institute of Paraíba is holding the second round of its rector election on Wednesday. Candidates Nicácio Lopes and Neilor César advance to the runoff vote.

stories.title: O que pode mudar com o fim da escala 6x1? Senado retoma discussão nesta quarta-feira (7)

en.title: What could change with the end of the 6x1 work schedule? Senate resumes discussion this Wednesday (7)
en.summary: Brazil's Senate is debating a constitutional amendment that would replace the six-day-one-day-off schedule with a five-day-two-day-off schedule while maintaining current wages and reducing the workweek to 40 hours.

stories.title: Nobel de Química 2026 vai para pesquisadores do Japão e da França

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry goes to researchers from Japan and France
en.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discoveries explaining why life uses only one mirrored version of certain molecules.

stories.title: Cientistas do Japão e da França recebem Nobel de Química

en.title: Scientists from Japan and France receive Nobel Prize in Chemistry
en.summary: Researchers Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai receive the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discoveries in nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in organic synthesis.

stories.title: L’Oréal investe em cursos para profissionalizar criadores de conteúdo

en.title: L'Oréal invests in courses to professionalize content creators
en.summary: L'Oréal launched a training platform to help content creators improve their work and navigate professional challenges, expanding its professionalization efforts in the influencer marketing sector.

stories.title: Chefe do FMI diz a líderes econômicos: é hora de agir

en.title: IMF chief tells economic leaders: time to act
en.summary: The global economy faces competing pressures from an energy shock and artificial intelligence growth, according to IMF leadership communication to economic policymakers.

stories.title: Produção industrial da Alemanha se recupera apesar da volatilidade dos preços da energia

en.title: Germany's industrial production recovers despite energy price volatility
en.summary: German industrial production improved in August as manufacturers adapted to changing conditions caused by fluctuating energy prices.

stories.title: Inflação anual da Suécia sobe a 1,1% em setembro, mostram prévias

en.title: Sweden's annual inflation rises to 1.1% in September, preliminary data shows
en.summary: Sweden's annual inflation increased to 1.1% in September from 0.3% in August, driven primarily by higher energy prices, reaching its highest level since February 2025.

stories.title: Bolsas da Ásia recuam, apesar da recente alta impulsionada por balanços corporativos em Wall Street

en.title: Asian exchanges decline despite recent gains driven by corporate earnings on Wall Street
en.summary: Most Asian stock markets fell on Wednesday following record highs in U.S. markets, which had been boosted by expectations of strong corporate profits.
